scoring_justification: Headline numeric values are deterministic outputs of the DFT workflow; checker cannot re-run DFT, so result-level comparison with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for eta_B2u and polarization
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and main text (eta_B2u=0.86, polarization=71 pC/m)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from peer-reviewed paper reported numbers
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly from published, peer-reviewed values; traceable to the paper

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the soft-mode projection η onto B2u mode, the spontaneous electric polarization, and the piezoelectric strain coefficients d11 and d12.

output_contract.notes: The exact_match policy compares the reported values to hidden paper-derived reference numbers within hidden tolerances. All quantities are fixed deterministic results of the specified DFT workflow.

steps.description: Check that eta_B2u and polarization are within tolerance of paper values.
